messages:
elaine_cs: Heads-up — Klara Health showing a sustained API usage drop starting last Wednesday, ~62% down on token volume. Pulling full export now, but wanted to flag asap.

marta_csm: Oof. Any spike in errors or latency or did they change integration?

elaine_cs: Infra looks clean (no error increase). Quick query I ran: 
```
SELECT date, SUM(tokens) FROM klara_usage WHERE date >= '2026-02-01' GROUP BY date ORDER BY date;
```
Drop is abrupt after 2026-03-02 (around when they onboarded a new PM).

kevin_am: New PM + no Slack contact yet? Who's the new stakeholder?

elaine_cs: Procurement looped in a new technical lead (Jordan R), not in our workspace. Also heard they did a short competitive eval with BlueOps last week.

raj_se: Got it. Do we know model/config they tested? If they compared our 8k context instance vs BlueOps' compressed pipeline, cost/latency could be the driver.

marta_csm: From my convo with L. Reynolds last week: top concerns were pricing predictability and integrated analytics for care workflows.

kevin_am: Proposed next steps: 1) 15m exec QBR to resurface value, 2) technical enablement session for Jordan + engs, 3) offer 30-day burst credits and a co-demo + migration plan. Agree?

elaine_cs: +1. Also recommend a set of tailored prompt templates for their care use cases — that'll reduce token usage and show quick ROI.

raj_se: I'll run a concise perf vs cost comparison vs BlueOps (latency, tokens per call, tail p95) and include kernel/quant notes. ETA: tomorrow EOD.

marta_csm: I'll draft the QBR invite and a 1-page ROI projection that shows monthly savings at current and optimized token levels. Need that by Fri close.

kevin_am: If legal can sign off on a short appendix for the trial extension, we can offer a 6-week pilot with performance SLAs. That usually calms procurement.

procurement-bot: Reminder: renewal for Klara Health scheduled 2026-05-12 — 51 days remaining. :calendar:

elaine_cs: Perfect. Raj — ping this thread when perf doc is uploaded. Marta — please cc me on the QBR invite. I'll assemble a 6-slide re-onboarding + quick wins deck.

marta_csm: Will do. tagging next steps: @kevin_am handle legal ping, @raj_se perf doc, @elaine_cs re-onboard deck. :thumbsup:
